verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a cloud compute and sandbox platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents cron, schedules or recurring workflows for Modal Sandboxes. The evidence covers only on-demand, programmatic sandbox creation and one-off command execution; the community-built GitHub Actions runners are a user-side arrangement, not a Modal scheduling feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
